title: SDD contract manifest (specs/contracts/manifest.json)
description: Declares the project type, the observable interfaces, which machine contracts exist, and every deliberate deviation from the Equivalence Profile.

artifacts.description: Artifact key (see contract-matrix.json) -> file name inside specs/contracts/.

notApplicable.description: Conditional artifact key -> justification for omitting it.

equivalenceTarget.description: 1 (default) = oracle-conformant: one build, oracle 100% green against the lock. 2 = equivalence-verified: a second build made from the frozen set alone plus a zero-divergence `oracle.cjs diff` / `diff-ui`; set it only when the user asks for the second build, since it repeats Stage 05.

equivalenceTargetDecision.description: Optional DECISION_LOG id recording the user's choice of target (useful when it changes after the first freeze, or to say why L2 was asked for). Must cite an existing DECnnn when present.

prototypeCadence.description: "slice" (default): every slice runs 01 → 02 → 03 → 04 before the next one starts. "rolling": several slices are prototyped (01 → 02 each, to the user's acceptance) before one hardening pass; `transition --completed 01` is in order right after an accepted prototype, and the slice cap is enforced at Stage 03 for everything accumulated since the last lock.

equivalenceCadence.description: Applies only when equivalenceTarget is 2: when the second build and the zero-divergence diff are required. "iteration" (default): every slice. "release": intermediate slices certify L1 with an explicit "L2 pending" row in EQUIVALENCE_REPORT.md; L2 is certified with `transition --completed 07 --release` before a release. Never claim L2 for a pending slice.

sliceCap.description: Maximum declared outcomes (operation statuses + CLI exit codes) this slice adds — those not recorded in the last spec.lock.json; default 150. Larger scope is split into slices, each running 02 → 07. Raising it requires sliceCapDecision.

sliceCapDecision.description: DECISION_LOG id recording the user's decision to exceed the default slice cap (required when sliceCap > 150).

coverageExempt.description: Coverage item (e.g. error:INTERNAL_ERROR, op:getHealth:503; `*` wildcards allowed) -> why it cannot be exercised black-box, or { class } naming a coverageExemptClasses entry that carries the justification.

coverageExemptClasses.description: Named exemption classes (e.g. unreachable-5xx, fault-injection-only) -> one justification reviewed once for every coverageExempt item that cites the class.

budgets.description: Per-stage budgets shown by `sdd.cjs readiness` against actuals (counts, never a block). Defaults: interviewQuestions 12, prototypeVersions 3, swarmRounds 3.
